entry.title: Give everything, or only what is asked
entry.summary:
A thought I started and left pending: should someone give everything at one shot and let me take what I need, or give only what I asked for, so the noise stays out? I want both, on different days.
I have not finished thinking it through, so for now I am leaving my open tabs here. If you have the time, read them and decide for yourself.
